what_it_is: Astra Microwave Products Limited is a Hyderabad-headquartered, listed Indian RF and microwave subsystems manufacturer serving defence and space programmes. Its product set spans radar subsystems, electronic-warfare modules and counter-UAS elements such as perimeter intrusion detection radar, delivered both directly and through joint ventures. The company is a significant supplier into Indian radar programmes including DRDO's radar ecosystem.
india_angle: Astra Microwave has an active India order book: a JV with Rafael Comsys bagged a reported Rs 255.88 crore MoD order in December 2024, and in 2026 the company reported a Rs 2,205 crore order from HAL for the Uttam AESA radar programme supplying equipment for Tejas Mk-2. Its counter-drone product page markets perimeter intrusion detection radar for Indian users.
intelligence_assessment: Order-flow reporting from exchanges and business media makes Astra Microwave one of the better-documented Indian C-UAS/radar subsystem suppliers, but JV-level C-UAS deliveries and end-customer attribution are less transparent. Watch HAL Uttam execution and any dedicated counter-UAS radar tenders as revenue-confirming signals.

faq.q: What does Astra Microwave Products make?
faq.a: RF and microwave subsystems for defence radar, electronic warfare and space, plus counter-UAS elements such as perimeter intrusion detection radar.

faq.q: What recent orders has Astra Microwave won?
faq.a: Business media reported a JV order of about Rs 255.88 crore from MoD in December 2024 and a Rs 2,205 crore order from HAL in 2026 tied to the Uttam AESA radar programme.
Yes - Astra Microwave Products Limited trades on Indian exchanges (NSE/BSE).
